title: Skip post-login user option and go directly to dashboard

requirements.text: Remove any post-login user-option/selection step so that immediately after a successful Internet Identity login the app renders the main dashboard (AppShell) without requiring the user to choose an option.

quotes: do not use user option after login get directoly to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login, the first screen shown is the main dashboard (AppShell).
No intermediate screen/dialog that asks the user to pick a 'user option' is shown after login.
The dashboard loads with its normal default tab selection (current default is the Clients tab).

requirements.text: Ensure that first-time profile setup (when the caller profile is missing) does not block entry into the dashboard; it may appear as a modal on top of the dashboard, but the user must still be taken directly to the dashboard shell after login.

quotes: do not use user option after login get directoly to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: When the caller has no saved profile, the dashboard (AppShell) is still rendered immediately after login.
If a profile setup prompt is required, it appears as an overlay/modal on top of the dashboard rather than replacing it with a separate step/page.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Changing authentication provider (must continue using Internet Identity).
Adding new onboarding flows beyond removing the post-login option/selection step.
